name: Cuspline
tagline: The operating system for the modern dental practice.
positioning: Cuspline unifies scheduling, claims, and chair utilization into one operational layer built for owner-operator dental practices.

hero.h1: Run your practice by the numbers, not the paper chart.
hero.sub: Cuspline connects your front desk, chairs, and claims into one operational dashboard — so owner-operators can see production, collections, and open capacity in real time.

features.title: Chair Utilization Ledger
features.description: See open operatory hours, no-show gaps, and hygiene column density per provider — the exact minutes leaking from your daily production goal.

features.title: Claims Throughput Engine
features.description: Auto-scrub every claim against payer rules before submission, track aging buckets, and flag denials the day they post — not at month-end reconciliation.

features.title: Recall & Reactivation
features.description: Automatically surface overdue hygiene patients and unscheduled treatment plans, then route confirmation texts your coordinator can approve in one tap.

features.title: Treatment Plan Conversion
features.description: Track case acceptance from diagnosis to booked appointment, with per-provider conversion rates and the dollar value sitting unscheduled.

features.title: Compliance & Audit Trail
features.description: HIPAA-aligned access logs, retention policies, and staff permission tiers documented for every chart action across your locations.

features.title: Multi-Location Rollup
features.description: Consolidate production, collections, and payroll ratios across every operatory into one owner view — or drill into a single chair.

testimonials.quote: We recovered eleven hours of unbilled hygiene time in the first month. Cuspline showed us exactly which columns were running empty and why our recall list had gone stale.
testimonials.name: Dr. Marisa Holloway

testimonials.quote: Claims aging used to be a spreadsheet I updated on Sundays. Now denials get flagged the same day and my collections ratio is up nine points.
testimonials.name: Devon Priya Kapadia

testimonials.quote: As a two-chair owner-operator, I finally see production per provider without pulling three reports. The dashboard replaced my whiteboard.
testimonials.name: Dr. Alan Whitfield
